h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Hosur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Hosur

items.pText: Hosur sits on the Tamil Nadu side of the border with Karnataka, a short drive from Electronic City in Bangalore. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for housing projects, schools, factory townships and parks in Hosur. Everything is made at our factory in Vasai East, about 910 km away, and sent by road for installation by our team or a dealer.

Much of Hosur's growth has come from its SIPCOT industrial estates, and that shapes who buys play equipment here. Manufacturers build staff housing with family areas, schools have opened to serve those families, and gated layouts on the Bangalore side of town attract people who commute. Each of these sites needs a different kind of play area, which we plan from the site size, the age group and the photos you share.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Play areas for factory townships and staff housing

c: An industrial township usually has children of every age living in one place, from toddlers to teenagers. We plan these as zones: a toddler corner with low slides and
, a main structure for children aged 5 to 12, and open space for running games. Fencing between the play area and internal roads matters where delivery vehicles move through the colony.
If a company plans play areas for several colonies, sharing the full list at the start helps us keep the equipment and colours consistent across them.

richText.heading: Red soil, rock and a mild climate

c: Hosur stands on the same plateau as Bangalore, so its weather stays milder than the plains of Tamil Nadu. Children can play outdoors through most of the year, which means more wear on swing hangers, springs and bolts. A monthly check of the moving parts keeps everything in order.

Many open plots here have red soil over hard rock. Where the rock is close to the surface, digging for grouted posts takes more effort, and a self-standing base can be the simpler option. Send photos of the ground and, if you have it, the soil report from your civil contractor, and we will suggest the right method.
Villa layouts and apartment projects on the Bangalore side of Hosur usually want a play area that looks finished and fits a set plot. A compact structure from our
range puts slides and climbers into a small footprint. Schools want sturdier pieces that a whole class can use, with a separate area for the pre-primary section.

items.q: Do you install playground equipment in Hosur?
items.a: Yes. We send the equipment about 910 km by road from our Vasai factory and install it with our own team or a dealer serving Hosur and the area around Bangalore.

items.q: Can you supply play equipment for a company's staff colony?
items.a: Yes. Share the colony layout, the number of children and their age groups. We suggest separate zones for toddlers and older children and mark each safe play area on a drawing before quoting.

items.q: What if our site has rocky ground?
items.a: Send us photos and any soil details you have. Where rock is close to the surface, we may suggest a self-standing installation instead of grouting. Our team decides the method once we have seen the ground.

items.q: What warranty comes with the equipment?
items.a: Three years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. One year on springs, bearings and spare parts. The warranty covers manufacturing defects when the equipment is installed and looked after as per our instructions.
